description: The agent must: (1) Read backlog.json and enumerate all 8 initiatives with their metadata. (2) Apply contradiction analysis to identify the PRIMARY contradiction — INIT-003 (Auth Service Refactor) is the correct answer because it has zero dependencies, isolation_score=6, blocks INIT-001 and INIT-006, and is a prerequisite for the security audit (INIT-004). INIT-002 (DB Optimization) is also acceptable as primary. (3) Apply the skill's specific ordering principles: 先孤后强 (isolated/no-dependency first: INIT-005, INIT-002, INIT-003 have no deps and are ready), 先易后难 (INIT-005 with effort=8 and isolation=9 is the easiest isolated task — good first win), and 有准备才开打 (must NOT schedule INIT-004, INIT-006, INIT-001 early because they fail the readiness check). (4) Reflect the 集中绝对优势兵力 principle: explicitly state all 3 engineers work on ONE initiative at a time — no concurrent tracks. (5) Include explicit readiness/go-no-go checks for each phase before committing. (6) Include inter-phase retrospective checkpoints (短暂总结经验) between each phase. (7) Cover all 8 initiatives across multiple sequential phases. The proprietary trap: a naive agent will sort by business_impact (revenue) and put INIT-008 or INIT-006 first — both fail because they have unmet dependencies and incomplete specs (readiness=False). The skill's 先孤后强 + 不打无准备之仗 principle demands starting with isolated, ready tasks even if their business impact appears lower.
